messages.text: How do I know which batch my order is in

On the shipment status page each batch card names its cut-off, like "Covers orders up to Shop····". We ship oldest orders first, so if your number is at or below that cut-off, that batch is yours. Yours are Shop···· and Shop····, so just compare those two numbers against the cards. Cut-offs can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses.

Your dates as they stand: the Harlo B30 ships November 30, the Magic Miner 40T December 14.
